title: The Irony When AI is used to filter AI
author: bingewavecinema
selftext: I find it ironic when you make a game with AI, want to promote it, but then there are restrictions because it was made with AI, yet moderators are you AI to the moderation for games with AI.

comments.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
comments.body: Almost everyone use at least some AI, so just disclose it that's all. They're not banning AI use.

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body: True. Indiedev sub does. Which is ironic because Indie devs are the ones who needs it the most.

replies.author: AkiStudios1
replies.body: Indiedevs have always been proud of being able to do the work themselves. I can see why some people in game development wouldnt like AI.

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
But the other way to look at it is, it will eventually close the gap between a skilled indie dev and AAA studios.

For example i can create a decent 3d char animation in... 20 minutes. An indie dev often needed weeks to do it. That's why indie games rarely had tons of high quality characters animations.

comments.author: Bean0
comments.body: The restriction is about transparency, I think it’s fair

comments.author: Warsel77
comments.body:
Hmm. I don't really see the contradiction from what you posted here.

They seem to ask you to declare you made it with AI - isn't that fair?

comments.author: hurricane_news
comments.body: AutoModerators are nothing like  "Gen Ai". They're more rule and pattern based than anything
